content_zh:
有无天的谨慎，小天的强大，这一路倒是平安无事。
火云宗这两个多月平静不下来，自从火世将消息带回去后，火云宗几乎出动宗内所有弟子，前去河中查探。但一天天过去，始终没有找到令牌，也没发现无天的尸骨。
最后火云宗宗主火真人亲自出面，联合十大长老，使用大神通，将河水蒸干，剖开所有水妖，却一点蜘丝马迹也没找到，更别说令牌。
火真人大怒，训斥火世，前往龙村，两个多月过去，原本残破不堪的村子，已经彻底被草木覆盖，却没有任何妖兽驻地，甚至连一只飞虫都没，一片死寂！
众人惊疑，一名长老运用法诀，显现出了缘由。
村口草木之下有一墓地，葬着几十具白骨，有老有少，有男有女，这是一个乱葬岗。
为什么！！！
还我命来！！！
墓地上空，一道道怨气交织，始终不散，诉说着哀与恨，那一张张狰狞的面孔，在嘶吼，在嚎叫，在悲呼，使妖兽不敢靠近，让众人心悸！
“火世，这就是你做的好事？！”
火真人傲立当空，身着红大袍，红光满面，甚至连头发胡须都是红色，整个人如一簇火焰，气势磅礴，深不可测！
他的声音很冷，有一种无上威压，在他面前，火世不敢发出半点声音，低下头高傲的头颅，极度害怕。
“回宗后，去火焰山面壁思过，十年不得踏出半步。”语气很霸道，这是上位者的威严。
闻言，众人都吸了一口凉气，显然火焰山这个地方，并不是什么善地。
“大哥，世儿这次的做法，确实欠缺考虑，但无可厚非，他这样做，是为了宗门着想，还请从轻发落。”一个中年男子求情。
“他骄纵跋扈，滥杀无辜，都是被你们惯出来的。令牌是重要，但宗门名声更重要，此事若是传出，你让天下人做何感想，那些信任我们的村落，还会有谁愿意将后人放心交予火云宗？”
火真人不怒而威，双眸精光爆绽，似两轮烈日，璀璨夺目，无人敢直视。
“大哥，何不给世儿一个将功补过的机会，炎宗两个月后要招收弟子，就让世儿带人前去，半路将那些具备体魄的孩子拦截，纳入我火云宗。”
中年男子身披黄金甲，金光闪烁，身体很魁梧，他是火世的叔叔，宗主的亲弟弟，火云宗的副宗主，这里只有他敢与火真人辩解。
“副宗主说得有理，火世千错万错，但本意是为了宗门，宗主何不网开一面，给他一个将功赎罪的机会。燕儿，这次你也有错，便与他一同前往。”

一道苍老的声音从远处传来，一束五彩神光划破空气，停在半空，那里瑞彩喷薄，五光十色，朦胧一片，看不真切。但气势浑厚，堪比山河，此人比前两人还要强大！
刘燕红唇开合，想说什么，看了身旁的火世，却说不出口，她点头应道。
沉默少许，火真人道：“火世，此次前去，必须完成任务，若不然，少宗主的位置就该换人了。”
火世身体一颤，面色发白，面前这位熟悉而又陌生的人，向来是说一是一，他不会去怀疑真假。
“孩儿定不负所望。”火世恭敬道。
他心里很悲哀，拥有独特的身份，在外人看来，威风八面，光芒万丈。实际上，他一直生活的很累，时刻都要提防着，小心着，不敢有一丝松懈。
对少宗主这个位置，有人已经觊觎已久，他不能做错一点事情，不然就会从神坛跌落，摔得粉身碎骨！
“老二，即刻发出通缉令，宗门叛徒无天，偷秘典，杀同门，十恶不赦，丧心病狂，凡报信者，奖五百精元，活捉者，奖五千精元。至于这里的冤魂，你自己处理，别留下任何痕迹。”
火真人说完，火焰滔天，滚滚而去。
“燕儿，多加小心。”五彩瑞光中，苍老的声音叮嘱，而后冲天而去，不知所踪。
其他人亦是遁光离去，现场只剩下金甲中年，火世与刘燕三人。
“嘿，怨恨这么深的冤魂，还是第一次遇见，刚好试试新炼成的法宝。”金甲中年大手一挥，眉心光芒闪烁间，一道黑光掠出，停在半空。
那是一面黑色小旗，能有巴掌大，上刻有许多复杂的文字，如蝌蚪在游荡，散发着阵阵阴寒之气，阴森而恐怖！

content_en:
With Wutian's caution and Xiaotian's strength, the journey was uneventful.
Huoyun Sect has been unable to calm down for more than two months. Since Huo Shi brought the news back, Huoyun Sect sent almost all the disciples in the sect to investigate the river. But day after day passed, the token was never found, nor was Wutian's body found.
In the end, the leader of the Fire Cloud Sect, Huo Zhenren, came forward in person, teamed up with the ten elders, and used great magical powers to evaporate the river water and cut open all the water monsters. However, no trace of it was found, let alone the token.
Huo Zhenren was furious, reprimanded Huo Shi, and went to Long Village. More than two months later, the originally dilapidated village had been completely covered by vegetation, but there were no monsters stationed there, not even a flying insect. It was completely silent!
Everyone was shocked and confused, and an elder used the magic technique to reveal the reason.
There is a cemetery under the grass and trees at the entrance of the village, where dozens of bones are buried, including old and young, men and women. This is a mass grave.
Why! ! !
Give me back my life! ! !
Over the cemetery, lines of resentment intertwined and never dissipated, telling sorrow and hatred. The ferocious faces were roaring, howling, and crying, making the monsters dare not approach and making everyone's hearts tremble!
"Huo Shi, is this a good thing you did?!"
Master Huo stands proudly in the sky, wearing a red robe, his face is full of red light, even his hair and beard are red, his whole person is like a cluster of flames, majestic and unfathomable!
His voice was cold, with a kind of supreme pressure. In front of him, Huo Shi did not dare to make a sound, and lowered his proud head, extremely afraid.
"After returning to the sect, I will go to the Flame Mountain to face the wall and think about my mistakes. I will not be able to take a step forward for ten years." The tone was very domineering, which was the majesty of a superior.
Hearing this, everyone took a breath of cold air. It was obvious that the Flame Mountain was not a kind place.
"Brother, Shi'er's actions this time are indeed without consideration, but it is understandable. He did this for the sake of the sect. Please give him a gentle sentence." A middle-aged man pleaded.
"He is arrogant and domineering and kills innocent people indiscriminately. It is all because of you. The token is important, but the reputation of the sect is more important. If this matter comes out, how will you make people in the world feel? Among those villages that trust us, who will be willing to trust their descendants to the Huoyun Sect?"
Master Huo was not angry but powerful, his eyes were shining like two scorching suns, so dazzling that no one dared to look directly at him.
"Brother, why don't you give Shi'er a chance to make up for your mistakes? Yan Sect will recruit disciples in two months, so let Shi'er lead people there and intercept those children who have the physical fitness to join our Fire Cloud Sect."
The middle-aged man is wearing golden armor, shining with golden light, and has a very burly body. He is Huo Shi's uncle, the sect leader's biological brother, and the deputy sect leader of Huoyun Sect. He is the only one here who dares to argue with Huo Shizhen.
"The deputy sect master is right. There are many mistakes in the Fire World, but his original intention is for the sect. Why don't the sect master give him a chance to atone for his sins. Yan'er, you are also at fault this time, so go with him."
An old voice came from a distance, and a beam of colorful divine light cut through the air and stopped in mid-air, where the auspicious colors were gushing out, colorful and hazy, making it difficult to see clearly. But his momentum is as powerful as mountains and rivers. This person is even more powerful than the first two!
Liu Yan opened and closed her red lips, wanting to say something. She looked at Huo Shi beside her, but couldn't say anything. She nodded in response.
After a moment of silence, Master Huo said: "Huo Shi, when you go this time, you must complete the mission. Otherwise, the position of the young sect leader should be changed."
Huo Shi's body trembled and his face turned pale. The familiar yet unfamiliar person in front of him always said what he said was true, and he would not doubt the truth or falsehood.
"My child will definitely live up to expectations." Huo Shi said respectfully.
He is very sad in his heart. He has a unique identity. In the eyes of outsiders, he is majestic and shining. In fact, he has been living a very tiring life. He has to be on guard and careful at all times and dare not relax even a little bit.
Someone is already coveting the position of Young Sect Master.For a long time, he couldn't do anything wrong, otherwise he would fall from the altar and be shattered to pieces!
"Second brother, issue a wanted order immediately. The sect's traitor is Wutian. He steals the secret code and kills his fellow sect members. He is extremely evil and insane. Anyone who reports the news will be rewarded with 500 Jingyuan. Those who are caught alive will be rewarded with 5,000 Jingyuan. As for the wronged souls here, you should deal with them yourself without leaving any traces."
After Master Huo finished speaking, the flames rolled into the sky and rolled away.
"Yan'er, be careful." The old voice warned in the colorful light, and then flew away into the sky without a trace.
The others also fled away, leaving only the middle-aged Jin Jia, Huo Shi and Liu Yan.
"Hey, this is the first time I've met such a resentful soul, and I just happened to try out the newly made magic weapon." The middle-aged man in golden armor waved his big hand, and between his brows, a ray of black light swept out and stopped in mid-air.
It was a small black flag, as big as a palm, with many complex words engraved on it, like tadpoles wandering around, exuding bursts of cold air, eerie and terrifying!
